name: smartcampus-residences-backend
description: SmartCampus - Gestion des Residences : microservices Chambre, Demande, Contrat + passerelle API

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.start:dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n gateway,chambres,demandes,contrats -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run start:dev --workspace @residences/gateway" "npm run start:dev --workspace @residences/chambres" "npm run start:dev --workspace @residences/demandes" "npm run start:dev --workspace @residences/contrats"
